connector.name: COTI Private Messaging
connector.registryDescription: Private encrypted agent messaging, hidden state exchange, delegation, and private inbox workflows.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package coti-sdk-private-messaging. The credential requirement is not named, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the coti-io account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record marks at least one value as secret without naming the scheme. Read the source before you supply a credential.

env.name: PRIVATE_KEY
env.description: Private key for the agent wallet that sends, reads, and claims private messaging activity.

env.name: AES_KEY
env.description: COTI AES key for encrypting and decrypting private message bodies.

env.name: COTI_NETWORK
env.description: Optional network selector. Defaults to mainnet; use testnet only for intentional testing.

env.name: STARTER_GRANT_REF
env.description: Optional attribution reference for starter-grant and private messaging onboarding flows.
